verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an accounting SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk export feature, open-format download (CSV, JSON, etc.), or an account-exit path. The REST API, SDK and reports endpoints are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export, not the export capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
